/check_safety.description: Pure-CPU safety check. Runs BEFORE any @spaces.GPU resource is requested.

code_snippets.python:
from gradio_client import Client

client = Client("prithivMLmods/FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0-Fast")
result = client.predict(
	prompt="...",
	api_name="/check_safety",
)
print(result)
code_snippets.bash:
curl -X POST https://prithivmlmods-firered-image-edit-1-0-fast.hf.space/gradio_api/call/v2/check_safety -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "..."}' \
  | awk -F'"' '{ print $4}' \
  | read EVENT_ID; curl -N https://prithivmlmods-firered-image-edit-1-0-fast.hf.space/gradio_api/call/check_safety/$EVENT_ID
